resources.string: Exterior
Does the VIN on the windscreen match the registration certificate?
Are both number plates correct and securely fitted?
Do the colour and options match the paperwork?
Is the paint free of scratches, dents or defects on the driver\'s side?
Is the paint free of scratches, dents or defects on the passenger side?
Is the paint free of scratches, dents or defects at the front?
Is the paint free of scratches, dents or defects at the rear?
Are the door and boot openings free of scratches?
Are the doors properly aligned with the body?
Do the door handles sit perfectly flush on the outside?
Is the front trunk (frunk) properly aligned?
Is the tailgate properly aligned?
Are the gaps between the panels even and correct?
Are the windows free of scratches or defects?
Is the glass roof properly fitted and free of defects?
Is the windscreen free of cracks or flaws?
Do all four windows open and close properly?
Are the headlights and LEDs properly aligned with the body?
Are the headlights and LEDs free of condensation inside?
Are the wheels free of scratches or damage?
Are the tyres in good condition, with recent manufacturing dates (DOT)?
Are the sills and underbody free of damage (crouch down to check)?
Is the underside of the chassis free of transport scrapes?
Do the wheel arches have all their clips, properly fastened?
Are the valve caps on all 4 tyres?
Does the protective plastic for the front towing point come off easily?
Interior
Are the seats free of marks, stains or scratches?
Do the front seats\' electric adjustments work properly?
Do the rear bench\'s electric adjustments (if fitted) work properly?
Is the fabric trim free of marks, stains or scratches?
Are the interior plastics free of marks, stains or scratches?
Is the steering wheel free of marks, stains or scratches?
Does the steering wheel\'s electric adjustment work properly?
Do the steering wheel controls and stalks work properly?
Do the ceiling lights and the sun visor lights work properly?
Are the three floor mats (two front, one rear) there and in good condition?
Is the headliner properly aligned, the fabric in place everywhere and free of fingerprints?
Are the inside of the windscreen and the dashboard free of suction cup marks?
Are the front seats silent when they move in every direction?
Are the rear seats silent when folded down?
Software and connectivity
Are the screens responsive and free of scratches?
Is the screen free of dead pixels?
Does the software show the right information (mileage, battery type, software version)?
Does the car appear in the Tesla app?
Is the 4G/5G connection (LTE or 5G icon) active?
Does the GPS work properly (try a destination, such as your home)?
Do all the cameras (front, rear, side) work properly (check with the icon at the bottom of the screen or Sentry Mode)?
Does the audio system (the radio, for instance) work properly?
Does the microphone (the right steering wheel button) work properly?
Does the dashcam work?
Does the web browser work?
Does the Bluetooth connection with your phone work for passive entry?
Do all the mobile app features work (opening the charge port, venting, climate)?
Did you reset a trip meter renamed “SINCE PURCHASE - DO NOT RESET” to track consumption from the start?
Mechanical and electrical features
Do the doors open and close properly without excessive effort?
Do the front (frunk) and rear trunks open and close properly?
Are the door seals properly fitted and in good condition?
Does the glovebox open and close properly?
Do both key cards work properly?
Are the charge ports in good condition and working?
Is the current charge enough to reach your destination or a charger?
Are the boot and the under-boot storage dry?
Is the front trunk dry?
Is the charge port door aligned with the body, and does it open and close easily?
Is the steering wheel aligned with the wheels?
Do the mirrors adjust and fold properly, without noise?
Do all the lights work (indicators, flashing, fog, brake lights, etc.)?
Do the air conditioning and heating work at full power without unusual noise?
Does the front emergency release handle work?
Do the centre console storage and the glovebox work?
Does the 12 V socket charge a device?
Do both fast (DC) and slow (AC) charging work?
Accessories and equipment
Is the first aid kit there?
Is the warning triangle there?
Is the Type 2 charging cable there?
Is the USB drive in the glovebox?
[optional] Is the mobile charger with a 230 V plug there?
[optional] Is the tow bar there with its bag?
[optional] Is the tow bar\'s electrical socket in good condition?
Is the accessory under the front trunk mat (towing eye) there, and is there washer fluid?
Is the owner\'s manual in the glovebox?
